images.filename: Fort Christmas historical Park - Fort Entrance.jpg
images.caption: The entrance to the recreated Fort Christmas in Christmas, Florida. The fort is built with logs and chinked with cement, but provides an accurate representation of the original fort, built by the US Army in 1837, during the Second Seminole War on a site thought to be less than a mile from this modern replica.
